notes.data: Names were lowercased, stripped to a-z, deduplicated, and split by name before windows were made.
notes.boundary: The token '-' has id 0 and serves as start padding and the end target.
notes.axis: Embedding axis 1 was constrained during training with a margin penalty: vowels positive, consonants negative.
notes.display: The page displays two decimal places; all forward passes use these full-precision values.
notes.sampling: The exported names use seeded sampling at temperature 0.75.
